Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000526" [decision]: From 2025-06-09, the billing API is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, billing API)
- memory_id "1000057": The Boreal team looks after the bus.  (about: Boreal team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000368" [decision]: Marcus took over the Boreal team on-call shift from Lena on 2025-05-07.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000786" [decision]: As of 2025-11-06, Marcus has the Boreal team pager this cycle, taking over from Lena.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000586" [decision]: As of 2025-08-15, Marcus has the Boreal team pager this cycle, taking over from Lena.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000723": From 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings the Cinder team, not the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000561" [decision]: As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000261" [decision]: Lena takes over the pager rotation for the Boreal team from Marcus in the cycle starting 2025-03-17.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000409" [decision]: As of 2025-05-15, the webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000706": The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.  (about: Atlas team)
- memory_id "1000727": As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by the Cinder team, not the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000340" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000185": The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so the notifier is down whenever the bus is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000752" [decision]: As of 2025-10-24, Diego has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Yuki Tanaka.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder team, Diego)
- memory_id "1000682": As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000551": Tomasz left the Atlas team and joined team Dune on 2025-07-30.  (about: Atlas team, Tomasz, team Dune)
- memory_id "1000167": The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000778" [decision]: As of 2025-11-06, feature-flags is owned by the Ember team, which the Atlas team owned until then.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000502": As of 2025-06-11, team Dune owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then.  (about: Boreal team, team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000694": Team Dune noticed that the bus' CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.  (about: team Dune, the bus, the traffic shift)
